name: vlm-gateway
provider: hosted vision API — Vertex AI (default) or AI Studio Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic
adaptation: none — hosted general-purpose model, no fine-tuning
notes: R1 is not satisfied by this backend. Vertex AI is the default transport: it serves the same Gemini models from the project's own GCP account, billed per token rather than capped at the AI Studio free-tier daily request limit.

name: gee-land-cover
provider: Google Earth Engine — GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1, fallback ESA/WorldCover
notes: Queries the GEE catalog for the scene AOI and date range. The uploaded pixel array is never sent. Design Rule 2 is intact; Design Rule 3 (offline) is not.

name: gee-change-detect
provider: Google Earth Engine — COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED NDVI/NDBI differencing
adaptation: none — deterministic thresholded index differencing, not a trained detector
notes: Expect lower IoU than a trained Siamese U-Net on a labeled benchmark (PRD §11.2). Defensible on real, unlabeled queries. AOI + dates only, never the uploaded pixels.

name: gee-sentinel1-grd
adaptation: none — already-processed backscatter from the GEE catalog
notes: Optional acceleration only (PRD §7.5), opt-in via source='gee'. The deterministic local dB pipeline is the default, the primary path, and the only offline path — and is mandatory for RISAT and other non-catalog rasters.

name: deterministic-tools
provider: local computation — rasterio, numpy, scipy, scikit-image
notes: Exact, deterministic and fully offline-capable. These are the only tools scored in the ISRO/SAC offline evaluation mode (PRD §11.5).
